**页面标题**
- China Sample Size Proposal for Joining Pivotal Studies（Registration Purpose）

**说明文字**
- CD physicians will lead Local Project Team to evaluate and propose sample for registration purpose trial, as part of China integration plan.

---

## 表格内容（Evaluation Items / Considerations / Responsible）

### 1) Statistical Perspective（负责人：Statistician）
- PMDA Method 1：primary choice, to allow 80% chance to meet consistency criteria  
- PMDA Method 2：secondary choice  
- Special considerations for multiple comparisons and multiple trial participation

### 2) Regulatory Consideration（负责人：RA）
- 15–20% of overall study population in general  
- Sample size of successful precedents with similar indication

### 3) Operation Feasibility（负责人：ClinOps）
- Benchmark data reference（Internal & External, Global & Local）  
- Global strategic feasibility for reference, if applied  
- Preliminary feasibility evaluation, eg. EE feedback  
- Participation patient number of TW/HK and other East Asian countries, if available

### 4) Clinical Consideration（负责人：CD）
- Target patient population and medical practice in China  
- Rare disease in China or not  
- Mega trial  
- Sample size and data from early phase trials if China has joined  
- Sample size of trials with similar indication

---

## 决定/结论（页面可见要点）
- Team proposal is a balance of the four aspects.  
- If certain requirement cannot be met, LPT need to assess the risk and mitigation plan, and incorporate into China integration proposal.

## 行动项/注意事项（页面可见要点）
- Do not share unnecessary allocation details（esp. Mainland/TW/HK，which is internal execution-level alignment; default to Greater China sample size information only for HA communication）.
- CO will lead OPU feasibility; final commitment to individual study should rely upon final OPU allocation.
- If any deviation to proposed sample size by OPU feasibility, China development plan re-assessment and mitigation may be considered; please consider to raise to PEC and/or core team.
